BiblicalUsage: Palaiotēs occurs once: we are delivered from the law, having died to that wherein we were held, that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse names the whole change of the gospel: from oldness of the letter to newness of the Spirit, and the Spirit is where I serve now.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
